summary: Pineapple Financial Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing its board approved expansion of an existing share repurchase program from $3M to up to $15M of its common shares (NYSE American: PAPL). Repurchases may occur in open-market transactions under Rule 10b-18 and Rule 10b5-1 plans, effective immediately. The program is discretionary—no fixed number of shares or timeline is required, and it can be modified or suspended at any time. This capital return signals management's commitment to long-term value. Watch for actual repurchase cadence and potential EPS accretion; lacks a fixed tender price, so risk-arb is not applicable.
